Commentary.Commentary: PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold feels that the surface still looks to bat with no real uncomfortable patches on it although it could be on the slower side. Whatever rough spots have come are in the very full length zone and hence shouldn't be causing any problems. No real demons on the surface and the batsmen can score runs if they apply themselves.

Hello and welcome for the fourth day's play. The rain gods had the final say yesterday due to which the third session was completely washed out. The conditions are overcast for now but there is no immediate threat of rain. Let's keep our fingers crossed and hope we get full fledged action. Will Sri Lanka continue to strengthen their authority on the game or will Bangladesh pacers make use of the overcast conditions and chip in with quick wickets? Stay with us to find out...
...DAY 4, 1ST SESSION...

A good day for Sri Lanka. They were slightly put under pressure by Bangladesh's openers yesterday but once that stand was broken, there was no stopping them. Rahim and Mehedi did minimize the damage but the lead is still big. The final session being washed out due to rain has taken some time out of the game which will be some relief for Bangladesh but they still have a large task in hand. We shall have an early start tomorrow. Tune in at 0945 local, 0415 GMT for the fourth day's play. Till then, adios! Take care!
Update 1615 local - The inevitable has happened, the rain's impact has left a dent and so PLAY HAS BEEN CALLED OFF FOR THE DAY.
Update 1605 local - Some respite as the rain has stopped. Remains to be seen if we can sneak in an hour's play or not. Hang around for more updates.
Update 1545 local - The rain has gotten heavier and the ground is now fully covered. Doesn't look like we may have any more play today. There should be official word soon.

Update 1530 local - We were supposed to start but it has gone dark again and the umpires feel that it isn't bright enough for play to happen at the moment. As I type, IT HAS STARTED TO RAIN. The covers are coming on to the ground. Stay tuned for more updates.

Sri Lanka wrap it up quickly after the break. Skipper Rahim fought hard in the middle and got good support from Mehedi Hasan and together they stitched a crucial 106-run stand and also avoided the follow-on. Perera removed Hasan and then the hosts cleaned the tail rather quickly. Early in the innings Tamim and Sarkar got the visitors off to a good start but none of the batsmen after them could contribute. Perera and Herath got 3-apiece while Sandakan along with the two pacers picked one each. The hosts have a huge lead and would look to swell it quickly before having a go at Bangladesh yet again. Stay tuned for the third innings...

OUT! BLINDER FROM MENDIS! Floated on middle, Mustafizur tries to flick but somehow the ball sticks to Mendis at forward short leg. He reacted sharply but still that wasn't a planned attempt at all. Pure reflex from the young man. BANGLADESH HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 312.
Fuller and outside off, driven towards mid off.
The players are back on the field. Rangana Herath to bowl...
Update 1500 local - It's not raining but the covers are out. The playing area is not covered yet. The groundsmen are standing there, maybe expecting some rain soon. Stay tuned for latest updates.
...DAY 3, THIRD SESSION...

Decent session for Bangladesh as they fought back with the Rahim-Mehedi partnership. Both looked at ease and it seemed like the visitors would get closer to the Lankan score but Dilruwan struck twice in successive balls to dent the recovery and he was the pick of the bowlers in this session. Rahim's impressive knock then came to an end when he was bowled by his Lankan counterpart before bad light forced an early tea. With the deficit 182, it's the hosts firmly in control. Join us in a short while for the final session, weather permitting.
It's gone very dark out there and the umpires have decided to take an EARLY TEA ON DAY 3. Smart decision. The ground staff is ready with the covers near the boundary ropes.
Floats it up around off, punched towards point for a single.
Flattish through the air, defended off the back foot again.
Flighted delivery around off, defended into the ground.
Fires it outside off, Rahman leaves it alone.
Flattish through the air, defended off the back foot.
Loopy ball around off, driven towards short extra cover.
Around off, defended off the back foot.
Pushed outside off, Rahman comes forward to defend but gets an outside edge wide of first slip. He picks up three runs.
MUSTAFIZUR RAHMAN is the last man in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Rangana Herath gets the better of his counterpart! He lets out a loud roar in delight! Fires it full around off, it's the arm ball from the Lankan veteran. Rahim makes room to push at it but the ball sneaks through his bat and disturbs the off stick. Herath then winks and boy, what a swag he's got! Rahim walks back after a brilliant innings! Tea extended by 30 mins now!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floats it up around middle, Rahim advances down the track and lofts it down to long on. Doesn't run and rightfully so.
Flatter outside off, punched off the back foot to cover.
Floats it up around off, Roy looks to defend but once again gets an inside edge.
Tossed up around off, SR comes forward to defend but gets a thick inside edge on the pads.
Short outside off, cut behind point for a single.
Rahim comes down the track and hence the bowler drags his length short, Rahim could only defend it.
Short around off, chopped towards backward point.
Rahim goes back to push but gets a bottom edge as the ball bounces over the stumps.
Pushed through the air, Roy somehow manages to punch it back to the Herath.
That's a brave leave! Fired full outside off, very close to the off pole, Subashis leaves it alone.
Roy once again gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Quicker through the air around middle, Roy looks to defend but gets an inside edge.
Loopy ball around off, pushed back to the bowler again.
Tossed up around off, driven back to the Lankan skipper.
Around the pads, flatter through the air, flicked towards mid-wicket but won't get a single.
The groundsmen get ready for their duties. Strong breeze moving across the stadium as well...
Loopy ball around off, defended into the ground.
Drops it short and outside off, Mushfiqur goes back and dabs it backward point for a couple.
FOUR! Rahim on the charge! Tossed up around middle and leg, Rahim comes down the track and hoicks it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Gets behind the line and keeps it out.
It has gone very overcast at the moment...
Full and around middle and off, Rahim comes forward and defends.
Yes, he does! Floats it up around off, Roy comes forward to defend but the ball turns away a bit and beats the outside edge.
Around middle and leg, flicked through square leg for a single. Can Roy survive the last ball?
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Loopy ball around off, Rahim drives it past the man at extra cover but doesn't run. He wants to take maximum strike!
Tossed up around off, defended off the front foot.
Rahim gets down and across to paddle it towards fine leg for a couple of runs. 300 up for Bangladesh!
Flatter outside off, Roy punches it towards mid off. A double-wicket maiden for Perera!
Flatter one around middle and leg, Roy gets hit on the pads.
Full and around off, defended towards cover-point.
Misses a Hat-Trick by a whisker, my word! Pushes it quicker through the air around off, Roy takes a good stride forward to defend but the ball just goes past the outside edge to the keeper.
SUBASHIS ROY walks in next to face the Hat-Trick ball!

OUT! IT'S HITTING THE WICKETS! Two-in-two for Perera! Good use of the technology there! Perera bowls a tossed up ball around middle and leg, Taskin presses forward to defend but seems to have missed the line. Gets pinged on the pads and another appeal follows. This time the umpire shakes his head. Sri Lanka opt for the review. The TV umpire first sees a lot of replays to see if there is an inside edge or not. He confirms that first, there isn't. Then the Ball Tracker shows it's pitched in line and was going on to hit the leg stump. Taskin bags a golden duck.
A loud shout of another LBW against Taskin is referred upstairs!
TASKIN AHMED is the new man in!

OUT! PLUMB IN FRONT! Sri Lanka finally manage to get a breakthrough! Perera pushes it quicker through the air around middle, skidding through the turf, Mehedi instead of countering it off the front foot goes back to defend. Misses the line and is trapped right in front of the stumps. They appeal and umpire Erasmus raises his finger. A beautiful 106-run stand comes to an end!
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads.

Good stop from Lakmal! Loopy ball outside off, Hasan drives it along the ground through covers. Lakmal gives it a long chase and does well to scoop the ball back. The umpire refers it upstairs to see if his hand made contact with the rope when he had the ball in his hand. Benefit of doubt given to the fielder as they pick three.
Tossed up around off, once again it's pushed towards covers.
A slider going down leg, Hasan misses his flick.
Full on the stumps, Mushfiqur looks to defend but gets an inside edge behind square on the leg side for a single. BANGLA TIGERS AVOID THE FOLLOW-ON!
Full and around off, Rahim leans forward and pushes it towards covers.
Rahim tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Tossed up ball around middle and leg, eased down to long on for one.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, defended from within the crease.
100-run stand between Rahim and Mehedi!
Loopy ball around middle and leg, flicked a bit uppishly through mid-wicket for a single.
Short and around off, punched off the back foot towards cover-point for one.
In the air... safe! Loopy ball around off, Rahim gets down to sweep but gets a top edge. Shouts for CATCH IT! but it falls well short of Sandakan at deep backward square leg. A single taken.
Flattish through the air around middle, defended by covering the line.
Comes forward and smothers it away.
Tossed up on off, driven straight to short extra cover.
Full outside off, MR prods forward in defense.
Flatter one around the pads, nudged behind square on the leg side for a couple.
Pushed quicker through the air outside off, cut square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Meets the pitch of the ball and defends it towards FSL.
FOUR! Neat work! Tossed up around off, Rahim gets down and across and paddles it fine down the leg side for a lovely boundary. Is growing in confidence is Mushfiqur!
No ball! Full on middle and leg, flicked past short leg for a single. It's called as a no ball as Perera oversteps!
Goes back and defends it towards short leg.
Loopy around off, Rahim comes down the track and bunts it down to long on for a single.
Tossed up around off, Rahim comes down the track and hits it back to the bowler. Perera bends to stop but the ball goes off his hands and then hits umpire Erasmus on the left boot.
DILRUWAN PERERA into the attack now!
Drinks break....Excellent comeback by Bangladesh, courtesy this fantastic stand.
Drifting in from outside off, Mehedi gets on the front foot and smothers it to the ground.
Fuller and outside off, reaches out and blocks it solidly.
Flatter and around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
FOUR! Misfield by Sandakan! Floated invitingly outside off, Mehedi forces the drive through covers as Sandakan lets it through. The ball speeds away to the fence for a boundary.
Loopy and outside off, looks to block but gets it off the inside half to short leg.
Flighted outside off, leans forward and strokes it down to long on for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Mehedi rocks back to that one and defends solidly with the full face of the bat.
Short of a length outside off, punched off the back foot through cover-point as the batsmen get a brace.
Banged in short on middle, Mehedi ducks under it.
Full and outside off, gets on the front foot and defends solidly towards cover.
Length ball around leg stump, Rahim misses the flick and is struck on the pads. The ball rolls near him as the batsmen steal a single.
Shortish and angling across the right-hander, Rahim tries to flash the cut but misses.
Fuller and outside off, leans into it and defends solidly.
Loopy on a length outside off, Rahim decides to play the late cut almost as an afterthought. Gets a single towards backward point.
Flighted on middle and leg, Rahim gets forward and defends it on to the track.
Arrows it in around middle, tucked towards square leg for an easy single.
Flatter ball around off, stays on the back foot and defends solidly.
Tossed up outside off, crisply driven towards mid off.
Dug in short on leg stump, Rahim ducks under the bumper with ease.
Full and outside off, punchy drive but straight towards cover.

FOUR! Delightful stroke! Back of a length outside off, Rahim camps back and cuts it beautifully through backward point towards the fence for a boundary. A bit uppish but well wide of the gully fielder. Got on top of the bounce very well.
Length ball outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Fuller ball outside off, Rahim drives it towards mid off. A bit of shape away for Lakmal in this spell.
Full and outside off, leans forward and pushes it towards cover.
Flatter ball outside off, sits on the back foot and defends well.

NOT OUT! Big inside edge and Mehedi survives! Flatter ball around off, pings him on the pad and there is a massive lbw appeal which is given by the umpire. After a chat with his captain, he takes the review. Legal delivery and replays show a thick inside edge before the ball raps the back pad. Wonder how the batsman wasn't aware of such an edge. Anyway, he survives. Good use of the technology.
Mehedi has been given out lbw. He opts for the review. Only the impact can save him.
Full and outside off, defended well off the front foot.

FOUR! Smart batting! This young man continues to impress, he was good against India and is looking solid today as well. This is a flighted ball on middle, he steps down the track and lofts it straight down the ground over mid on. Goes to the fence on a few bounces.
Very full around middle, gets across and drills it towards mid on.
Slider outside off, Mehedi looks to block and the ball hits him high on the bat.
RANGANA HERATH is back on.
Length ball wider outside off, seams away a bit but the line is too wide to make the batsman play.

Length ball closer to off, left alone to the keeper.

Sri Lanka will hope that the new ball provide them some respite.

Flatter outside off, Mehedi hangs back and eases it through point for a single.
Floated around off, Mehedi defends it solidly from the crease.
Flighted outside off, presses forward and defends it solidly.
Flatter outside off, gets back and cuts it through point for a brace.
Floated outside off, Mehedi gets across and blocks it solidly.

Length ball outside off, no stroke offered to that one.

16th Test fifty for Mushfiqur Rahim!
Length ball outside off, patted towards cover-point for a single. It's been a responsible knock from him.
Good length angled in from around off, defended off the back foot towards short mid-wicket.
Floated outside off, invites the drive and Mehedi obliges by easing it through the covers for a couple.
Slightly short around middle, stays back and dabs it towards short leg.
Tossed up around off, presses forward to that one and defends solidly.
Flatter on middle and leg, Rahim gets back and clips it through backward square leg for a single.
Around the wicket.
FOUR! Poor ball! Once again down the leg side, this time Rahim premeditates the sweep and takes it on the full. Gets a boundary at fine leg. Rank bad ball from the chinaman.
Slips down the leg side, Rahim misses the flick due to extra bounce.
Another bumper to end the over. Mehedi gets under it comfortably.
Short ball outside off, Mehedi ducks under the bumper.
Dug in short on middle and leg, swivels and pulls it down to long leg for a single.

FOUR! Smashed! Short on middle and leg, gets back to that one and pulls it away through backward square leg for a boundary. Top stroke! Brings up the 50-run stand. Valuable on for the visitors after the hole they got into before lunch.
Good length outside off, gets back and makes a leave to that one.
Slightly short outside off, sits back and cuts it through point for a single.
Floated outside leg stump, spins down the leg side, a bit of bounce as Rahim misses the flick.
Drifting in from middle, gets back and clips it in front of square on the leg side for a single.
On a length outside off, stays back and pushes it towards short cover.
Loopy around leg stump, gets across and works it towards short mid-wicket.
Tossed up gently on middle, Rahim gets forward and smothers it to the ground.

FOUR! Just past the keeper! Drifting on to the pads, Rahim gets across to flick it away but probably gets it bit too finer than he wants to. Dickwella dives to his left full length but cannot reach it as the ball whistles towards the fine leg fence.
Good length around off, pushed towards cover for a brisk single.
Dug in short around leg stump, harmless line and Mehedi ducks easily under it.
Gets into a tangle! Dug in short just outside off, doesn't bounce much as Rahim takes his eyes off the ball to evade it. He is lucky that he didn't cop a blow there.
Fuller and around off, angling in, gets across and works it towards short mid-wicket.
Floated around leg stump, Rahim tries to flick but misses.
FOUR! That's been smashed! Drops it short outside off, rocks back and hammers the drive through extra cover for a boundary. Positive intent by Rahim after lunch. Good to see.
On middle and leg, Mehedi gets back and clips it on the leg side for a single.
Floated on the pads, worked gently towards the leg side.
Once again the line is outside leg, spins down the leg side as Mehedi misses the flick.
Floated around leg stump, spins down the leg side, Rahim gets back and clips it it behind square of the wicket on the leg side for a single.
LAKSHAN SANDAKAN comes on to bowl. Just the one over for Herath and he takes himself off the attack. Must say that he has underbowled himself so far by his usual standards.
Full and angled in from around off, nicely blocked off the front foot down the track.
Back of a length outside off, Rahim plays it with an angled bat towards square third man for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, tucks it away through backward square leg for a single. It wasn't that far away from the fielder at backward short leg.
Goes shorter outside off, Mehedi isn't interested to play at it.
FOUR! Nice stroke! Kumara misses the yorker and dishes out a low full toss outside off, Mehedi feasts on it with a well-timed drive through the covers. Races away to the fence.
Starts with a fuller ball outside off, Mehedi pushes it towards mid off.
LAHIRU KUMARA to bowl from the other end.
Shortens the length outside off, Rahim camps back and blocks towards cover.

SIX! Positive blow! Floated outside off, Rahim uses his feet well to get to the pitch of the ball and lofts it cleanly over long on for a maximum. Nice intent straightaway after the break from the Bangladeshi skipper.
On a length around off, Rahim defends it solidly from the crease.
Floated on a length outside off, Rahim stays back and blocks solidly.
Drifting in from outside off, Rahim hangs back and taps it towards point.
Fuller on middle, Rahim gets on the front foot and blocks solidly.
Welcome back for the second session. Can Bangladesh provide some resistance or will the Lankans mop up the lower order quickly? We shall find out. RANGANA HERATH to bowl the first over after lunch.
.....DAY 3, SESSION 2.....

Sri Lanka's session easily. They snared four wickets for the cost of 80 runs this morning. Lakmal removed Sarkar early in the session and that set the tone as wickets kept falling. The hosts' pacers impressed while Sandakan once again caused most problems. Amidst the ruins, skipper Rahim has stood tall but he is running short of partners. Mehedi was lucky to be put down just before the break. The visitors still need 82 more to avoid the follow-on and it's all going the Lankan's way at the moment. Join us in a while for the second session.
Flat, short and well outside off, Mehedi winds up for a cut shot but then it seems he realizes it's time for the break, so just leaves it alone. LUNCH DECLARED ON DAY 3!
Lunges forward and keeps it out safely.
Tossed up around off, defended off the back foot.
Silly point moves to second slip.

NOT OUT! Hasan first survives a DROP and then a run out! Hands on head moment for Lakshan! He sends out a googly, which turns away, Mehedi goes back to cut but ends up guiding it straight towards Gunaratne at first slip who tries to take a reverse cup catch but the ball doesn't stick. In fact it bursts off and goes over his head to third man. The batsmen are busy running and Mehedi wants to come back for the second. Asela throws it towards Dickwella who deflects it onto the stumps. They appeal for a run out now and it's taken upstairs. Replays show Hasan's back leg was in the air but his bat was grounded. Two runs taken. Can Bangladesh avoid further hiccups before the break?
Lot of drama, a dropped catch and they are checking upstairs for checking the run out.
Tossed up around leg, driven towards the man at mid on.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, defended in front of the short leg fielder.
Slows it through the air around off, Rahim keeps it out smartly.
Full on middle and leg, flicked uppsihly towards mid on where Perera tries to stop it with a dive but fumbles. They take a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flattish on middle and off, defended with a straight bat.
Short and outside off, MH goes back to cut but finds the fielder at point.
On the leg stump, easy pickings for Rahim as he flicks it through the leg side for a single.
Tossed up outside off, asking Hasan to go after it. He obliges but the ball just about beats the outside edge.
Around middle and leg, clipped past short leg for a single.
Wrong 'un! This one obviously turns away as Rahim looks to cut it away. Gets a bottom edge which bounces just past the off pole as the keeper collects it with his right hand.
Pushes it quicker through the air around middle, MR covers the line and defends it down.
Outside off, flatter through the air, left alone easily.
Comes from over the wicket and loops it up around off, it's turning in, Rahim defends it by covering the line.
LAKSHAN SANDAKAN is back to have another crack before lunch.
Flighted around off, pushed towards covers for nothing.
Drops it short outside off, Hasan looks to cut it away but chops it towards point off the bottom edge.
Tossed up around off, Mehedi defends it solidly.
Full and floated around off, Hasan drives it off the outer part of the bat towards point.
Quicker through the air around middle, defended off the back foot.
Full on middle and leg, flicked through backward square leg for a single.
Fires in a yorker on middle and leg, Rahim bends forward and bunts it past mid on. Not enough legs but will collect three.
Once again climbing up on the batsman who does well to fend it away.
Again goes short but this time the angle is down the leg side, Rahim sits under it calmly.
Back of a length ball on middle, Mushfiqur hangs back in defense.
Short again and outside off, defended off the back foot.
The physio is out there to have a look at Rahim. He seems okay but will certainly be shaken a bit by the blow. He has a change of helmet.

FOUR LEG BYES! That's really nasty! Rahim gets a beating here! Kumara bangs in a short ball, it shoots off the deck, Rahim wants to sway away from it but has no time in doing so. It hits him on the helmet and flies over gully for a boundary. He immediately removes his helmet and the Lankan fielders come around him in concern.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Herath gives it a truck loaded with flight outside off, Hasan takes a good stride and creams it past covers to pick up another boundary. 200 up for Bangladesh!

FOUR! Good use of the feet! Tossed up around off, Mehedi gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it sweetly through extra cover. Mid off was interested in giving it a chase but then gives up seeing the ball running away in a flash.
Full around off, Hasan lunges forward in defense.
MEHEDI HASAN is the new man in!

OUT! Edged and gone! Rangana Herath strikes for the first time! Flatter around off, skidding through the surface, Liton looks to punch it through the off side but gets an outside edge towards first slip where Asela Gunaratne takes a sharp low catch. Bangladesh are slipping now.
Floats it up around middle, pushed towards covers.
Tossed up around middle, defended with a good stride forward.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Here comes the sucker ball! After trying the short balls, Kumara fires it full and angles it in. Das looks to flick but gets it off the inner half of the bat towards mid-wicket for one.
Wide! Hits the deck hard, this lad is bowling is heart out here. On this occasion the ball rises a bit more as the batsman ducks under it. It's too high and has been called as a wide by the umpire.
Touch short around off, punched off the back foot to covers.
FOUR! Liton's eyes lit up when he sees the width! It's short and served outside off, Das stays put and just steers it through backward point for a boundary to open his account.
Short again and outside off, Mushfiqur cuts it straight to the cover-point fielder for a single.

Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Lovely stop! Full and outside off, Das makes room and absolutely drills it towards covers. Dilruwan dives to his left to make a superb stop. Prevented a certain boundary there!
Loopy ball around middle and off, Das presses forward to defend but gets an outside edge which rolls wide of the first slip fielder.
Gets behind the line and keeps it out.
Tossed up around off, driven towards mid off.
Tossed up around middle and leg, flicked past short leg for a single.
Back of a length ball on off, Liton defends it off the back foot. A superb over from Lahiru!
Full and fired well down the leg side, Das looks to flick but fails to do so.
LITON DAS is the new man in.

OUT! Off stump goes for a walk! What a sight for any pace bowler! But not if you are Mahmudullah, you just don't want to look behind. He hurls in a length ball, angling in, Mahmudullah presses forward to defend but the ball straightens a touch, beats his defense and goes on to uproot the off stump. Kumara is all pumped up, early in the day a few misfields would have let him down but this will get him going. Bangladesh still trail by 310 runs!
Short of a length ball outside off, Mahmudullah drops his wrists to let it go.
Wide! Digs in a short ball on middle, the batsman ducks to evade it.
Once again sprayed down the leg side, Mahmudullah looks to tuck but fails to get bat on ball.
Strangled around the pads, clipped fine down the leg side for a single.
Tossed up around middle and off, defended again.
Takes a good stride forward and defends it down solidly.
A touch flatter around off, defended off the back foot towards covers.
This one keeps a bit low but the batsman does well to block it out.
Full and around middle and leg, Mahmudullah brings his pad and bat together to defend.
Full and around off, driven straight to short extra cover.
Switches again to over the wicket and angles it in from around off, defended down gently.
Bangs in a short ball outside off, Mushfiqur arches back and lets it go.
Comes from around the wicket and slants it away from the batsman, Rahim has no harm in defending it again.
Gets behind the line and offers a nice back foot defense as the ball rolls down to mid on.
Short and down the leg side, Rahim moves inside the line to let it be.
Back of a length on middle, kicking off the deck, Rahim hops and fends it away on the on side.
Tossed up around off, pushed towards covers for nothing.
Full around middle and leg, Mahmudullah looks to flick but it goes a bit uppishly and just about evades the man at short leg.
Floats it up around middle, it's defended down into the ground.
Gets forward to this full ball and defends it down solidly.
Loopy outside off, defended off the front foot towards silly point.
Tosses it up from around the wicket, Mahmudullah prods forward and keeps it out.
RANGANA HERATH brings himself into the attack! A slip, short leg and silly point in place. Short extra cover and short mid-wicket are in place too.
Fuller and once again it's fired on the stumps, Rahim gets across and flicks it behind square leg. Lakshan in the deep does well to keep them down to a couple.
Good length ball on off, the Bangladesh skipper gets behind the line and offers a straight bat defense.

Nicely angles it in, on a fuller length on the stumps, Rahim jams it out towards the man at mid on.
Good length ball outside off, Mushfiqur stays back in defense.
Spears in a full ball on the stumps, it's clipped down to fine leg for a single.
LAHIRU KUMARA is brought into the attack now!
Drinks are on the field!
Floated on middle, reaches out and whips it away towards mid on.
Flatter on middle, Rahim camps on the back foot and defends towards short leg.
Very full on middle, Rahim squeezes it out towards mid on.

Dean Jones makes an interesting point on air. The third ball of this over was very full and he feels Rahim should have skipped down the track and should have taken it on the full but Bangladesh aren't picking Sandakan. They fear if he bowls a wrong 'un, they might be in trouble. Lakshan knows he is threatening the visitors to the core...
Fuller and outside off, reaches out and pats it towards mid off.
Drops it a bit short outside off, slapped to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Rahim works it away through mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length outside off, sits back and guides it towards point.
Another short ball around off, once again it's well directed and this time Mahmudullah is better prepared to evade it.
Good length on fourth stump line, Mahmudullah lifts his bat to make a leave.
That's a brilliant delivery! Well directed bouncer on off, Mahmudullah somehow manages to sway away from it just in time.
Back of a length outside off, stays back to that one and defends it firmly to the off side.
That was close! Dug in short on middle, extra bounce and Rahim hops across to fend. In the air for a while but gets it past the backward short leg fielder for a single.

FOUR! Good shot! Half-tracker from Sandakan and Mahmudullah is on to it in a flash. Rocks back and punches it sweetly through the covers. Nicely struck and the ball speeds to the fence for a boundary.
Tossed up very full around off, squeezed out towards silly point.
Flatter and around off, camps back and blocks it solidly down the pitch.
Tossed up invitingly outside off, pushed uppishly through the covers for a couple.
MAHMUDULLAH is the new man in, replacing Shakib!

OUT! SANDAKAN STRIKES! It's a big wicket as well. Not a wicket-taking delivery as it was a wrong 'un that was going down the leg side, Shakib looks to tuck it away but ends up getting a faint tickle on it. Good take by Dickwella behind the stumps and Shakib doesn't even wait for the umpire's decision as he walks off. They check for the no ball, no problems there. Body blow to Bangladesh. They still trail by 324.
Shakib has been given out. They are checking for the no ball.
Flighted outside off, Shakib leans forward and drives it towards mid off.
Banged in short down the leg side, left alone comfortably by Rahim.
Dug in short around off, Rahim ducks under it.

Has that carried? No, JUST SHORT! Length ball outside off, Shakib flat bats the drive straight back down the track. Doesn't carry to Lakmal who looks to stop it in his followthrough but it stings his hand and the ball goes down the ground to long on. The batsmen take a run in the process. Let's hope the bowler is fine.
Fuller ball and outside off, Shakib reaches out and crisply drives it through the covers for a couple.
Length ball outside off, leans forward and pushes it towards the off side.
Length ball outside off, gets forward and drives it towards cover.
Almost a replica of the previous ball, Rahim gets well forward to a loopy delivery and makes a leave.
Drifting away from outside off, Rahim gets a big stride forward and then lets it pass.
Flighted outside off, Rahim gets across and sweeps well towards deep backward square leg for a brace.
On a length outside off, Rahim stays back and defends solidly to the off side.
On middle and leg, worked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Mid off drops back. Lahiru shifted to mid on!
Kumara is in the action again! Fumbles a fluent drive from Shakib at mid off and allows the batsmen take a couple. Probably the bad bounce did him in this time.
Rahim has a change of gloves...
Dug in short on middle, Rahim does well to ride the bounce and fends it towards short leg who is stationed a bit deep.
Dug in short around off, Rahim ducks under the bumper.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and pushes it towards cover for a quick single.

SIX! THAT'S GONE ALL THE WAY! Short ball and Shakib goes for a wild pull but hasn't got the control at all. Doesn't matter as the top edge flies way over fine leg for a maximum. Whoa, some power that is from the all-rounder.
Full and outside off, Shakib gets across and drives it back to the bowler.
Short of a length angled in from around the wicket, Shakib stays back and chops it towards point.
Fuller and outside off, driven strongly towards mid off where Kumara doesn't fumble this time.
Loopy and outside off, Rahim looks to sweep but misses.
Floated outside off, stays back and dabs it towards point.
Gets through! Floated on a length outside off, Shakib gets back to cut but gets the edge that just falls short of first slip. Gets through him towards the deep as the batsmen run three.

FOUR! Poor from Kumara! This was tossed up nicely outside off, Shakib powers the drive towards Kumara who charges to his right from mid off but fails to gather it. The ball goes through him to the fence for a boundary. Bonus runs for Shakib.
Tossed up generously outside off, Shakib drives fluently but straight to short cover.
Back of a length around off, Rahim rises on his toes and fends it firmly on to the pitch.
Length ball around off, Rahim gets across to that one and blocks solidly.
Short leg is a bit deep.
Length ball angled in on middle, tucked in front of square of the wicket for a single.
Length ball angled in from outside off, Shakib gets right behind the line and blocks.
Around the wicket.
Back of a length outside off, Shakib hangs back and punches it through the covers. Nicely timed and he gets a couple to get off the mark.
Good length around off, Shakib stays back and taps it on to the track with a closed bat face.
Flatter outside off, Rahim stays on the back foot and blocks well.
Fullish outside off, drives gently towards the covers.

NOT OUT! Not a legal delivery! Nicely looped outside off, Rahim is beaten in flight and Dickwella whips off the bails in a flash. The stumping appeal is referred upstairs, replays show that Sandakan has overstepped and so that settles the deal. Don't need to look further.
Stumping appeal referred upstairs. Dickwella seems confident but Rahim seems unfazed.
Fuller and outside off, Rahim moves forward and defends solidly.
Bonus run! Full and outside off, pushed towards mid on for a single. The throw at the bowler's end is off target and the batsmen get the second run as well.
Fuller and outside off, leans forward and defends solidly.
Floated around off, Rahim goes for the slog sweep but gets beaten.
SHAKIB AL HASAN is the new man in.

OUT! LAKMAL STRIKES! Sarkar was probably expecting the ball to be fuller and shaping away, gets surprised by the bumper and goes late on the pull. Doesn't control it at all and gets a top edge towards fine leg where Kumara takes a very comfortable catch. Perfect start to the day for Sri Lanka with the well-set Sarkar's wicket. Good knock but he should have converted this into a big one.
Around the wicket for the left-hander.
Banged in short around middle, Rahim rises on his toes and controls the extra bounce to nudge it towards square leg. Single taken.
Short ball this time and Rahim responds by ducking it.
Good length outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Good length around off, defends it with a closed bat face towards short mid-wicket.
Fuller and around off, moves across and pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Hammered! Sandakan drops it short once more, third time in the over and Sarkar doesn't need second invitation. Stands tall and thrashes it through the covers to find the fence.
Gives it a lot of loop around off, Sarkar gets forward and blocks solidly.
Short again outside off, Rahim stays back and punches it towards deep point for a single.
On the shorter side slightly this time, allows Rahim to block off the back foot to short cover.
Lovely ball around off, spinning in sharply, Rahim hangs back and adjusts in time to block.
Short leg and silly point in place for Rahim.
Tossed up very full around middle, Sarkar drives it down the ground to long off for a run.
He was really impressive yesterday and Bangladesh couldn't really pick him. Let's see how he fares today.
LAKSHAN SANDAKAN to bowl from the other end.
Dug in short, going down the leg side as Rahim evades comfortably.
Good length on off, Rahim gets right behind the line and defends solidly to short mid-wicket.
Something bothers Rahim and he pulls away at the last moment. Lakmal is forced to abort his run up.
Dug in short on middle and leg, Rahim ducks under with ease.

Sloppy by Perera! Length ball outside off, Rahim stays back and pushes it towards point. Dilruwan fumbles due to the bad bounce and lets it through to the deep. He gives chase and cuts off the boundary. A couple to the Bangladeshi captain.
Good length around off, Rahim camps back and offers the full face of the bat in defense.
Fuller and on off, angling in a touch, Rahim covers the line and blocks.

The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. Crucial first session for Bangladesh as they need a partnership of substance. SURANGA LAKMAL to start proceedings on day three. Two slips and a gully in place along with a leg slip. Here we go!

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold says that the bowlers will be getting a lot of turn today. Adds Bangladesh's challenge will be to pick Sandakan. Adds there are a few balls that misbehaved yesterday and he won't be surprised if it happens today as well. Further says it's still a good wicket to bat on and the key to runs will be the patience level shown by the batsmen, provided they trust their defense.

Bangladesh's first aim will be to avoid the follow-on but as the pitch in sub-continent is expected to take the turn usually from day 3, it won't be that easy to score runs freely. Still remains to be seen how they counter against the Lankan spinners today. Stay tuned for all the action...

Hello and a warm welcome for day 3 of this Test match. Bangladesh after having a tough time with the ball, came out all guns blazing with the bat as openers Tamim and Sarkar laid a solid platform by stitching together a fabulous opening stand. However, Tamim departed and soon Mominul was sent back. Sarkar and skipper Rahim are out on the field and the visitors would be hoping that the duo bat long to reduce the deficit to as much as possible.
... DAY 3, SESSION 1...

For a major part of the innings, the pitch seemed docile but Sandakan's introduction changed it with the chinaman bowler extracting some turn and bounce through his wrist spin. Dilruwan too found some rhythm while Herath was a bit off target. Earlier in the day, Dickwella and Perera joined Mendis in the fun with the bat as Sri Lanka posted 494. Bangladesh did come back well after lunch though. Their batsmen have complemented the efforts too but a lot of work is still to be done. Join us at 1000 local, 0430 GMT for the third day's play. Till then, it's goodbye from us.

A balanced session to end the day and the game is evenly poised. Tamim and Sarkar stitched a superb century stand to set up Bangladesh's reply strongly. The former's comical dismissal gave Sri Lanka the opening and Dilruwan capitalized by removing Mominul cheaply to neutralize the hard work done by visitors' opening pair. Sarkar along with skipper Rahim saw off the remaining overs without damage to ensure that things were level at stumps on day two. The former has made full use of the reprieve he got early in the innings and has looked fluent ever since.

A googly around middle and leg, Soumya Sarkar jams it out towards short leg who flicks the ball back to the keeper as Sarkar drags his feet back in time. With that, an enthusiastic Dean Jones on air shouts - STUMPS ON DAY 2!
Comes from around the wicket and bowls a quicker one around middle, Sarkar digs it out towards silly point.
Karunaratne is moving to silly point. More company for Sarkar near the bat.
Very full around middle and leg, worked towards square leg for nothing.
Short and turning away, Sarkar reaches out and cuts it towards backward point.
Down the leg side, SS misses his flick and it's a good take from Niroshan behind.
Pushes it slower through the air around off, blocked down.
Herath gives this one a nice loop around off, Rahim comes forward to defend but the ball rolls off the outer part of the bat past first slip. A maiden from the Lankan veteran!
Pushed off the front foot towards covers for nothing.
Floats it up around off, MR lunges forward in defense.
Tossed up outside off, Rahim buries it into the ground.
Full around middle and off, Rahim presents a solid defense.
Tossed up around off, Mushfiqur defends it nicely off the front foot.
RANGANA HERATH is back on!
Loopy ball around off, Sarkar presses forward in defense.
SS lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Full and down the leg side, Soumya gets down to sweep but misses.
Once again Sarkar tries to poke but the ball turns away to get past the outside edge.
Around off, it's spinning away, SS goes for the cut shot but is beaten by the away turn there.
FOUR! Where did that come from? Full and spinning away after pitching, Sarkar takes a long stride forward and drives it past covers for a boundary.
Quicker through the air around middle and off, Rahim goes back and defends it with a straight bat.
Rahim presses forward and defends it into the ground.

Tossed up outside off, Sarkar comes down the track and drives it towards short extra cover. Chandimal dives to stop but he ends up parrying it to mid off. The fielder at mid off was running to his right already anticipating that Chandimal won't be able to stop that one. They take a single.
Flattish on middle and leg, flicked through square leg for a single.
Full around off, Rahim defends it off the front foot gently.
Tossed up around off, Rahim gets back and defends it off the back foot.
Lunges to a full ball and defends it safely.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
Sarkar has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Appeal for an lbw! Sandakan lets out a wrong 'un, Sarkar fails to defend it off his front foot and is rapped on the pads. They appeal but the umpire shakes his head. The replays detect an inside edge.
Gets forward and punches it to extra cover.
Flighted and full on off, it's driven off the front foot to covers.
Too full and on off, it's worked with the spin to short mid-wicket.
Fuller and outside off, presses forward and blocks it towards cover.
Drifting in from around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
MUSHFIQUR RAHIM walks out to bat.

OUT! DEAD PLUMB! Dilruwan strikes! Flatter and around off, Mominul plays back to that one and is struck on the pads. That was as plumb as it gets and he has to go. All of a sudden, the Lankans have their tails up. This was a poor shot selection from Haque as he just got stuck there.
Quicker ball outside off, stays back and defends it towards the off side.
Floated around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
DILRUWAN PERERA is back.
Floated on middle and leg, left alone to the keeper.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and drives it towards long off for a single.
Floated on a length outside off, Mominul gets back and defends solidly.
Flatter outside off, sits back and defends solidly.
Floated on middle and leg, Haque gets across to play the wrong 'un but is struck on the pads. Appeal for lbw but turned down.
Tossed up outside off, Sarkar drives it through covers. One run added to the total!
Haque gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks this floated delivery.
FOUR! Haque comes down the track and whacks this tossed up delivery towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary. Brilliant intent from the southpaw early on!
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Loops this one on middle, Haque drives it to mid-on.
Haque dead-bats this tossed up delivery.
Shorter and going in, Haque tucks it away through fine leg.
Tossed up outside off, Sarkar drives it towards covers.
Fuller and on the sticks, Sarkar jams it away.
Bowls this one way outside off, Sarkar has no reason to play at it.
Loops this one around middle, Sarkar leans forward to defend but the ball spins and whizzes past his willow.
Brings this one in sharply, Sarkar reads it well and cuts it very late towards point.
Tosses this one outside off, Sarkar looks to cut but it spins and goes past the outside edge.
Flighted outside off, reaches out and blocks it solidly.
Fuller on off, gets forward and drives it towards mid on.
Fuller on middle, gets across and clips it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Floated outside off, Haque reaches out and defends solidly.
On middle and leg, clipped away on the leg side for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed gently towards cover.
MOMINUL HAQUE walks out to bat.

OUT! ABSOLUTE COMEDY! No other way to describe this dismissal. Tamim has to walk back, hurt and embarrassed. This was a flatter ball around leg stump, he missed the flick and the ball brushed the pads en route towards the keeper. There was a big appeal for lbw and Tamim meanwhile sets off for a single, don't know why, without realizing that the ball is in Dickwella's gloves. Very cheeky stuff from him and one must say that he duped Iqbal completely. Has a big grin on his face as he whips the bails with Tamim way down the track. What a waste of a wicket and just the opening Sri Lanka wanted.
Shorter and outside off, cut towards point, where the fielder dives to make a good stop.
Iqbal gets behind the line of this floated delivery and buries it onto the ground.
Loops this one outside off which spins away, Iqbal leaves it alone.
Defends this tossed up delivery towards the leg side.
Unleashes the wrong 'un! Draws TI forward to defend but it whizzes past the inner half of his bat to the keeper.
Comes down the ground to this looped up delivery and knocks it back to the bowler.
Shorter and going in, Sarkar tucks it away through fine leg for a double.
A faster delivery and lot fuller, Sarkar waits in his crease and stonewalls.
Bowls this one on middle and leg, Sarkar clips it towards mid-wicket.
Sarkar works this floated delivery towards the leg side.
FOUR! Tossed up around off, Sarkar kneels and sweeps it hard through square leg for a boundary. Amazing stroke that!
Iqbal pushes this floated delivery towards the point region.
Floats this on around off, Iqbal gets his front foot ahead and lets the ball go through to keeper.
Tosses this on middle, Iqbal lunges and buries it onto the ground.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shorter and outside off, Iqbal cuts it away with the turn towards point. Two runs added to the total!
Iqbal waits for the turn and pushes this tossed up delivery towards covers.
Leg bye! Bowls it slightly quicker and down the leg side. Iqbal looks to tickle it away but it goes off his pads towards fine leg. They run a leg bye.
Iqbal drives this tossed up delivery towards covers.
Loops this one on middle, Sarkar clips it through mid-on for a single.
Shorter and flatter, Iqbal tucks it away through fine leg. One run added to the total!
Bowls this on middle, Iqbal flicks it away.
Tosses this one around middle and leg, Iqbal works it around towards the leg side.

NOT OUT! Height was definitely not the issue, inside edge was. Bowls it slower through the air, Sarkar leans forward to defend but gets rapped on the pad. Sri Lanka appeal but it is turned down. Herath reviews it after a discussion with his players. And the replays indicate there was an inside edge!
Sri Lanka opt for an LBW review against Soumya Sarkar. It looks close, maybe height is the issue!
Shorter and turning in, nudged away through square leg. One run added to the total!
Tossed up outside off, drilled through covers for a single.
Brings this one back, Sarkar reads it early and punches it towards point.
A similar delivery by Sandakan, Sarkar watchfully leaves it.

Bowls it slower through the air, which spins away, Tamim looks to push it towards covers but it takes the outside edge and goes past first slip. The fielder there chases it to cut it off. Three runs taken!
Goes forward to this floated delivery and dead-bats it.
Loops this one around middle, Sarkar blocks it towards FSL.
Floated on middle, Sarkar knocks it down the ground.
Tossed up outside off, Sarkar is rock solid in defense.
Tosses this one outside off, Sarkar drives it straight to the cover fielder.
21st Test fifty for Tamim.
Bowls this on the pads, Tamim works it away through mid-wicket for a single. A fine innings from the southpaw.
Drifting in from around off, defends it solidly from the crease.
Fuller and outside off, reaches out and thumps it down the ground to long off for a single.
Slightly shorter outside off, Sarkar sits back and punches it through cover for a run. Superb partnership this, it has laid the platform perfectly for the visitors.
Flighted outside off, reaches out and pats it away down to long off for a run.
Flatter and well outside off, Tamim gets well forward and pads it away.
2nd Test fifty for Sarkar.
Tossed up very full outside off, Sarkar squeezes it out to long off for a single. Fine knock from him, can he convert it into a big one?
Drinks break....
In the air but safe! Drifting in from outside off, premeditated sweep from Tamim but he is hit on the glove. The ball pops up for a while but dies down quickly as Dickwella tries to reach it in vain.
Tossed up around off, Sarkar gets across and forces it down to long on for a run.
Flighted on the stumps, powered down to long on for a single.
Floated outside off, gets on the front foot and defends solidly.
Flatter on middle, leans across and works it towards mid-wicket.
Floated outside off, steps out and pushes it towards extra cover for a single.
RANGANA HERATH is back.

NOT OUT! He is in comfortably. Floated outside off, Tamim pushes at it but gets the edge towards backward point. Comes down the track for a single but is sent back late. Lakmal hits the target at the keeper's end and they go upstairs for the run out. Replays show that Tamim had made his ground easily.
Direct hit from Lakmal at the keeper's end and they are going upstairs to check the run out. Tamim might have just made it.
Loopy around middle, Tamim looks to block but gets it off the inside half towards forward short leg.
Bowled slower through the air outside off, reaches out and pats it to short cover.
Drifting in from around off, reaches out to that one and defends solidly.
Flighted nicely outside off, crisply driven towards short extra cover.
On a length outside off, Tamim stays back to cut but gets a bottom edge towards backward point.
LAKSHAN SANDAKAN comes on to bowl. Can he extract something from this seemingly lifeless surface with his wrist spin? SL will hope so.

FOUR! Sweetly timed! Sarkar is chugging along merrily. Fuller ball on the pads, he shuffles a bit and flicks it elegantly through mid-wicket to find another boundary. THIS IS THE HIGHEST OPENING STAND FOR BANGLADESH AGAINST SRI LANKA.
Back of a length outside off, Sarkar steers it with an angled bat towards gully on the bounce.

FOUR! Naughty from Sarkar! Dug in short outside off, he stays back and calmly ramps it over the slips. Made such good contact that it nearly went all the way for a biggie. Watched the ball till the very last moment and that helped. He is now growing in confidence immensely.

Fuller and around middle, angling in, Sarkar misses the flick and the ball goes off the pads down the leg side as Dickwella makes the stop. Big appeal for lbw but that was going down leg. Dean Jones on air feels that this is a good ploy to get the batsman to flick with a leg slip in place.
Length ball angled into Tamim, he tucks it through backward square leg for a single.
Back of a length angled in from around off, tapped off the back foot towards point.
Quicker ball on middle and leg, stays back and tucks it towards square leg.
Drifting in from outside off, Tamim leans forward and eases it through the covers for a single.
Flatter on middle, Sarkar clips it on the leg side for a single.

SIX! WHAT A STRIKE! Terrific stroke from Sarkar. Nicely flighted ball around off, he dances down the track and hoists it cleanly over long off for a maximum. Nimble footwork did the trick. Both openers looking at ease right now. SL need a breakthrough soon.
Flighted outside off, Tamim uses his reach and pats it towards cover-point for a sharp single. Good running!
Flatter outside off, stays back and blocks it towards short cover.
Good length on middle, Tamim leans across and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish ball outside off, superbly driven by Tamim but straight to Chandimal at short extra cover.
Length ball outside off, Tamim presses forward and plods it towards cover.
Good length outside off, Tamim steers it towards point.
Full and angled in from around off, gets on the front foot and blocks solidly.
Bumper around off, Tamim somehow sways away from the short ball.
Flatter and on a length outside off, Sarkar hangs on the back foot and blocks it solidly.
Tossed up on middle and off, Sarkar skips down the pitch and blocks well.
Loopy and on middle, Sarkar leans into it and taps it towards forward short leg.
Floated outside off, pushes at it but gets an outside edge towards backward point.
Slider on middle, strikes Sarkar on the back pad and there is a big appeal for lbw. A very marginal call maybe and the umpire rejects the request.
Full and outside off, presses forward to that one and blocks it solidly to cover.
Iqbal lunges forward to this full ball and defends it down on the off side.
Short of a length ball outside off, cracked through cover-point for a single.
In the channel outside off, it's left alone by Tamim.
Wide! Bangs in a short ball on middle, Tamim doesn't play at it as the ball goes well over his head. Wide called by the umpire.
Comes forward to this length ball and pushes it strongly towards covers for a single.
Length ball outside off, Iqbal defends it off the back foot.
Short and outside off, Tamim plays inside the line and lets it be.
Loopy and outside off, Sarkar pushes at it but gets an edge that rolls to the off side.
Flatter outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Fuller and outside off, bunted down the ground to long off for a single.
Drifting in from around off, reaches out and smothers it to the ground.
Fuller and around off, gets the stride forward and blocks solidly.
Flighted from outside off, gets on the front foot and blocks it solidly.
Fuller and angled in from around off, gets across and defends solidly towards mid on.

FOUR! SLAPPED! Short of a length outside off, Sarkar gets half forward and pounces on the width with a flashy cut through backward point. Came a bit off the outer half but it was always intentional and picks up a boundary.
Dug in short just outside off, coming in with the angle, Sarkar sways away from the line.
Another full ball outside off, Sarkar eases it through the covers to the deep for a brace.
Fuller and outside off, Sarkar leans into it and pushes gently towards cover.
Shortish and outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Flatter outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Full outside off, drive through covers.
Tossed up on the stumps, blocked off the front foot.
Full around off, defended off the front foot.
Short and outside off, dabbed past short third man for a couple.
Full around off, driven towards covers.
Fuller on off, driven towards the man at covers.
Good shot! Kumara once again errs in line and keeps it full on the stumps, Sarkar bunts it down the ground past mid on for three.
Good length ball, angling in, Iqbal tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Changes the angle, comes from around the wicket and once again tries to be full but ends up bowling it on the pads. Tamim crouches low and across to clip it through square leg for back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! That's gone fine! Kumara sprays it full and down the leg side, Tamim just helps it on its way fine down the leg side for a boundary. Easy peasy for Tamim!
Low full toss on the pads, flicked through square leg for a single.
Loopy and outside off, reaches out and blocks it solidly.
Flighted outside off, Tamim drives it sweetly towards cover.
Quicker ball outside off, gets back to that one and defends firmly.
Fuller outside off, reaches out to that one and defends solidly.

DROPPED! Sharp chance but should have been taken. Short and outside off, Tamim sits back to cut it away but gets a thick edge that is put down by Dickwella. He isn't a frequent keeper and that has cost the Lankans here. How costly will this prove? Tamim is a big wicket without any doubt.
Flatter ball around off, Tamim sits back to that one and blocks it solidly.
Too straight from Herath and Sarkar works it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Fuller and outside off, presses forward and defends solidly.
Flatter around off, Sarkar gets right behind the line and blocks.
Floated on middle and off, whipped away down to long on for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and outside off, presses forward and blocks it solidly.
Floated outside off, reaches out and blocks it solidly.
Fuller around off, leans across and pats it back to the bowler.

FOUR! TOP SHOT! A bit short and outside off, Tamim sits on the back foot and essays a cracking back foot punch through the covers for a boundary. Struck it really well to pick up a boundary. He looks in good touch.
Full and outside off, presses forward and defends solidly.
Fullish on middle and leg, Sarkar nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter outside off, Sarkar stays back and defends solidly.
Flatter outside off, sits on the back foot and blocks it solidly.
Tossed up outside off, leans across and eases it down the ground to long on for a single.
Fuller outside off, presses forward and blocks solidly.
Flatter on middle, gets across and clips it away down the leg side for a single.
Fuller on middle, gets across and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Flatter outside off, stays back and punches it towards cover.
Drifting in from outside off defends it solidly off the front foot.
Full and outside off, Sarkar gets right behind the line and blocks.
Drifting in from around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Floated outside off, reaches out and defends it well from the crease.
Flatter and a bit short outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
Fuller and outside off, pushed through cover for a single.
Floated on a length outside off, defends it solidly from the crease.
Strays on the pads again, Tamim needles it down to fine leg for a run.
Flatter on middle and leg, gets across and clips it down to fine leg for a single.
On a length outside off, Sarkar stays in the crease and blocks with the full face of the bat.
Drifting in on middle, Sarkar nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller on middle, gets across and works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy on a length outside off, blocks it solidly from the crease.
Flatter on middle and leg, gets across and clips it down the leg side.
Floated outside off, reaches out and defends solidly.
Flighted outside off, crisply driven down the ground to long off for a run.
Flatter and on a length outside off, stays back and blocks well.
Slips one down the leg side, a bit of extra bounce as Tamim misses the flick.
DILRUWAN PERERA to bowl from the other end.
Very full and on the pads, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Well played by Tamim in the end. Slider around off, keeps a bit low but he does well to adjust and block solidly.
Drifting in on a length around off, stays in the crease and defends well.
Flighted on middle, gets across and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Floated outside off, reaches out to that one and smothers it to the ground.
Floated on middle, Sarkar wrists it away down to long on for a single.

Welcome back for the final session. The visitors will need to pocket this passage of play till stumps to compete in this game. The scoreboard pressure means that it won't be easy but not impossible considering the surface which is still good to bat. RANGANA HERATH to start after tea.
.....DAY 2, SESSION 3.....

Finally a decent session for Bangladesh. They took Sri Lanka's last four wickets for just 51 runs after lunch to minimize the impact of the hosts' batting. Tamim and Sarkar then managed to negotiate the phase till tea without being separated although the latter was lucky to survive a dropped chance at gully. In the context of the game, Sri Lanka are still well ahead and the visitors have a lot of work to do to stay afloat in the game. Join us in a while for the final session of the day.
Quicker one on middle and leg, Soumya Sarkar gets back and flicks it through mid-wicket. They wanted to come back for another but are happy with one. THAT SHALL BE TEA ON THE SECOND DAY!
Floated delivery around off, Sarkar offers a dead bat defense.
Slips it down the leg side, Sarkar looks to clip it away on the leg side but fails to get any wood on it.
Full and outside off, SS has got nothing to offer on that one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

A loud shout for LBW! Fires it quicker through the air around off, it skids through the surface, Sarkar stays behind to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. They appeal but the umpire says not out. Impact was marginally outside off.
Some issue with the sightscreen there. Sarkar isn't happy. Meanwhile, Herath is having a chat with Perera.
Fuller in length and outside off, Lakmal comes forward and pushes it towards Sandakan at point again.
Shuffles a touch and works it through square leg for a single.
Back of a length again, Soumya gets on top of the bounce and steers it towards Sandakan at point.
Back of a length ball outside off, kicking off the deck, Sarkar fails to put bat on ball.
A harmless length ball outside off, Soumya is happy to let it pass through to the keeper.
Fuller on the pads, flicked through square leg for a single.

A shout for an LBW! Flatter and quicker through the air around middle and leg, Sarkar gets back to work it on the leg side but misses and is hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW is turned down as it was going down leg.
Flighted ball around off, driven towards covers.
Loopy ball around off, defended off the front foot and into the ground.
Lets the ball come in and then offers a solid defense off the back foot.
Quicker one outside off, it's left alone with no fuss.
Short and turning away, Tamim plays with an angled bat towards backward point for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Sarkar comes forward to this one and keeps it out with a push towards covers.
Back of a length ball, served wide outside off, Sarkar looks to slash it through the line but once again the ball doesn't bounce and goes under the bat to the keeper.
On a length and doesn't rise. Sarkar does well to counter it.
Touch fuller and around off, driven on the up through covers for a comfortable couple.
Good length ball outside off, Sarkar plays it with soft hands and hence the outside edge goes safely towards gully.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Just short! Gives this one a decent amount of flight, it seemed the ball stuck, Iqbal comes forward to drive but the ball goes uppishly towards short extra cover where the fielder dives forward but the ball falls short.

FOUR! Aggression is Tamim! Once again sees the loop and decides to go after it. Advances down the track and spanks it over mid on. Clears the man there with utmost ease and bags another boundary to his name.
Loopy ball around middle and off, Iqbal defends it down by covering the line.
FOUR! Stupendous! Perera floats it up outside off, Tamim Iqbal doesn't want to let Perera settle in. Dances down the track and thumps it over extra cover for a boundary. Not a soul moved!
Starts with a tossed up ball outside off, Tamim gets back and cuts it towards backward point.
Good length ball on off, pushed straight to the cover fielder.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR! Edged and through! Unlucky Lakmal! You gotta feel for this lad! Once again serves a back of a length ball outside off, Sarkar comes forward to defend but gets an outside edge which goes wide of the third slip fielder who despite putting in a dive to his left fails to stop that one. The ball races away for a boundary.
Fuller on the pads, Sarkar gets across and works it wide of mid on. Herath goes for the chase and keeps them down to two.
Back of a length ball outside off, Soumya leaves it alone.
Good length ball, slanting away, Sarkar keeps his bat face open and pushes it towards backward point.
Good length ball, angling across, Tamim gets across to defend but gets it off the inner half of the bat.
Once again it's on a shorter side, Tamim stays in the crease and defends it gently towards covers.
In the channel outside off, easy leave for TI.
Short and some good bounce off the deck, Tamim hops and fends it away on the off side.
Shortish on middle and off, Iqbal offers a straight willow.
Back of a length ball on the hips, tucked to deep backward square leg for a couple of runs.

Edged but falls short this time! Touch short and in the channel outside off, Sarkar stays back and tries to fiddle with it. Once again an outside edge is induced but this time it falls short of the man at third slip. Quite an eventful over, this.
Angles it by going wide of the crease, this time it's flicked towards square leg.
Good length ball outside off, defended off the front foot towards the off side.

EDGED BUT DROPPED! Dilruwan Perera has spilled one! Lakmal goes wide of the crease and serves a fuller length delivery on off, Sarkar with no foot movement looks to drive but gets a thick edge which flies like a rocket to gully. Perera stationed there has no time to react as the ball bursts out of his palms, he then tries to take it on the second attempt but the ball is not in his range. It falls down safely and Sarkar gets an early reprieve.
Comes from around the wicket and bowls a length ball on off, defended from within the crease.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Drifting onto the pads and Sarkar is all over it. Brings his lovely wrists into play and flicks it through square leg for a rollicking boundary. A nice way to get off the mark.
Outside off, Tamim has no issues in letting it go.
Slightly shorter in length outside off, tapped towards the off side.
FOUR! You bowl to him on the pads and he will hit you all day and night! Fuller in length and angling in on the pads, Tamim finds it pretty easy as he flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good length ball on off, Tamim defends it firmly off the back foot to cover.
Very full and curling back in a shade, Tamim defends it down.
Comes steaming in and tries to pitch it up around off, Iqbal comes half forward and keeps it out.
LAHIRU KUMARA to share the new ball with Lakmal!
Fuller in the channel outside off, Soumya has got nothing to offer on that one.
Back of a length ball outside off, it's punched off the back foot towards covers.
Hurls in a full length ball close to the off stump, Sarkar comes forward and defends it with a solid straight bat.
Back of a length, slanting across the batsman, Sarkar hangs his bat as the ball goes just past the outside edge to the keeper.
Tries to angle it in but ends up serving one on the pads, Tamim gets forward and nicely clips it towards Herath at mid on for a quick single to get off the mark.
Starts off with a length ball around off from over the wicket, Tamim defends it off the front foot.
